svg.aria-label: The revision mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Peer reviewer: the instructions as items, or, with none, a review of the manuscript (agent); You approve the items (stop); Literature strategist, for a new reference (agent, only when needed); Visualization, for a figure (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: a patch per item (agent); Citation compliance (agent); Citation compliance once more, when a check fails (agent, only when needed); A claim the run cannot support, or a reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the entries fail the same check (stop); Peer reviewer: reading (agent); Draft writer: one pass (agent); Draft writer: reference fix (agent, only when needed); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); Draft writer: compile fix (agent, only when needed); /writing: 4 agents (agent); End: the report; your reply, optional (agent); Draft writer: applies what you pick (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: compile fix (agent, only when needed); Draft writer: the anonymous copy, for a double-blind venue (agent, only when needed).
